name: tiptap
title_zh: Tiptap 编辑器接入时先问你要协作还是批注的接线
tagline_zh: 改富文本编辑器最怕装错扩展白折腾。它按你的场景挑对扩展、给可跑代码，连 AI、协作、评论的接线方式都标清楚。
tagline_en: Stop guessing which Tiptap extension fits. It picks the right setup for collab, comments, or AI, with runnable.
desc_en: Helps coding agents integrate and work with the Tiptap rich text editor. Use when building or modifying a rich text editor with Tiptap, installing Tiptap extensions, or implementing features like collaboration, comments, AI, or document conversion.
why_zh: 它先问你要哪种能力，再给对应扩展组合和最小实现，而不是甩你一份全量 API。省掉试错。
why_en: It starts with your use case, then hands you the exact extension set and a minimal working snippet—no full-API dump, no trial.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Tiptap 2.x 的集成与扩展选型，不教 ProseMirror 底层原理；产物是代码片段和接线说明。
limit_en: Tiptap 2.x only; no ProseMirror internals. Outputs snippets & wiring, not full scaffolds. Useless for Tiptap 1.x or custom core.
title_en: Tiptap integration guide that asks collab or comments first
